verdict.rationale: Raygun documents smart filters that segment errors by date, location, version (release), host, OS, browser, and custom tags, and the changelog confirms a search results page with an error chart and filter-aligned CSV exports. There is no evidence of a real query syntax, cross-project search, environment filtering, or filtering on arbitrary custom properties. Missing for 10: documented query language/syntax, cross-project search, environment filter, custom-property filtering, independent or hands-on corroboration.
